trial_court_outcome.quote: convicted them under Section 302 read with Section 34 of the IPC. Accordingly, they were sentenced to undergo imprisonment for life
trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted all four under s.302/34 and imposed life imprisonment.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: After remand, High Court confirmed trial court conviction and sentence for all four and dismissed appeals
high_court_outcome.quote: After remand, the High Court confirmed the judgment of the Trial Court and dismissed the criminal appeals.
high_court_outcome.reason: Modification for A-3 was by the Supreme Court, not the High Court, which confirmed all convictions.

final_outcome.reason: All four accused remain convicted, with A-3's conviction altered.

offence_finally_established.quote: we hold him guilty of the offence under Section 304 Part II IPC
offence_finally_established.reason: Murder under s.302/34 for A-1, A-2, A-4 and s.304 Part II for A-3 matches the holding.

imprisonment_type.correct_value: Life imprisonment for A-1, A-2, A-4; fixed term (10 years) for A-3
imprisonment_type.quote: sentence him to undergo imprisonment for 10 years
imprisonment_type.reason: Fixed term applies only to A-3; the other three received life imprisonment.

imprisonment_years.quote: sentence him to undergo imprisonment for 10 years
imprisonment_years.reason: 10 years applies only to A-3; the others received life imprisonment.

fine_rs.correct_value: Rs. 500 each (trial court), default one month simple imprisonment
fine_rs.quote: to pay a fine of Rs. 500 each
fine_rs.reason: Judgment states a fine of Rs. 500 each was imposed by the trial court, not null.

neutral_facts.reason: Summary reveals the Supreme Court's modification of A-3's conviction, which must not appear in neutral facts.

physical_harm.reason: Severe bleeding injuries leading to death are described.

investigation_status.reason: FIR, charge sheet date and completed trial are all supported.

procedural_irregularity.correct_value: Courts mechanically drew s.34 inference against A-3 without analysing his role; High Court initially acquitted and was remanded
procedural_irregularity.quote: both the Courts have mechanically drawn an inference against A-3 under Section 34
procedural_irregularity.reason: Supreme Court found the courts mechanically inferred A-3's involvement without analysing his role, an irregularity.

appeal_history.reason: Trial conviction, initial High Court acquittal, remand, and Supreme Court modification are all supported.

prosecution_argument.quote: The case of the prosecution is that the accused 1 to 4 belonging to the same family

legal_principle_applied.correct_value: Common intention required for s.302/34; without it, participation with knowledge that act is likely to cause death attracts s.304 Part II (Camilo Vaz)
legal_principle_applied.quote: his participation in the assault and the wielding of the stone certainly makes him culpable
legal_principle_applied.reason: Omits the knowledge-based principle from Camilo Vaz that the court relied on for s.304 Part II.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: All four cases cited in the judgment are listed.

sentencing_rationale.reason: Court found no common intention for A-3 and held his stone assault culpable under s.304 Part II with 10 years.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: Court does not expressly list mitigating factors; reduction rests on lack of common intention.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Court does not expressly list aggravating factors in its sentencing analysis.
